description: Create a directory and any missing parent directories (mkdir -p behavior). Idempotent — succeeds even if the directory already exists. Returns whether the directory already existed. Errors: EEXIST if a file (not directory) already exists at the path.

path.description: Absolute path of the directory to create (e.g. /src/utils)

store.description: Named persistent store for cross-session access. Sessions are ephemeral (one per MCP connection); named stores persist indefinitely. Omit to use the session's own namespace.

name: mkdir
